Raise: Test.
Case: normal use - the check runs after manual removal, when `apps/api/app/people/__init__.py` is already modified. A regression that empties this file on a successful check, removing its retained model import, leaves its Git status as modified, so this comparison still passes. Test 3 checks that the file exists before the call, then stages the changes without checking its contents. The test therefore still cannot establish that the command leaves existing work unchanged.
